note: T-092 judging rigs (this task's own data file; pipeline/charsys/render_calibration.json is read-only and unchanged). Load with render_calibration.load(name, path=<this file>). character_warm_indoor/1 is character_neutral/1 with the same directions, angles, backdrop, view transform and exposure, and warm colour temperatures (ref_42 'Warm Indoor' validation tile); each strength is scaled by Y(neutral kelvin)/Y(warm kelvin) so the luminance of the front-facing irradiance stays that of the neutral rig and only the colour of the light changes.

character_warm_indoor/1.description: Warm indoor judging rig for T-092 material patches: character_neutral/1 geometry with a 3800 K key, 3200 K fill, 4200 K rim and 4200 K ambient, luminance-normalised to the neutral rig.
character_warm_indoor/1.backdrop_source: character_neutral/1 (unchanged, so only the subject's light changes)

lights.name: Key
lights.source: character_neutral/1 Key; 2.27 x Y(5800 K) 0.918 / Y(3800 K) 0.658

lights.name: Fill
lights.source: character_neutral/1 Fill; 0.637 x Y(4800 K) 0.793 / Y(3200 K) 0.572

lights.name: Rim
lights.source: character_neutral/1 Rim; 1.4 x Y(5600 K) 0.894 / Y(4200 K) 0.713

character_warm_indoor/1.azimuth_convention: camera-relative: 0 = from the camera, +90 = from screen-left, 180 = from behind the subject
